title: Before USB, every device had its own plug. PCs carried a crowd of different connectors, and USB was
description:
PCs carried a crowd of different connectors, and USB was created to make connecting devices fundamentally easier. It also set out to simplify software setup.

Compaq, DEC, IBM, Intel, Microsoft, NEC and Nortel began developing it in 1995. No single company or person owns the invention.

Intel architect. He and his team worked on the standard, and the first USB chips were made by Intel in 1995.

The Full Speed rate in USB 1.0, released in January 1996.

In 2009 an Intel advert made Bhatt a "rock star" of computing.

Sources:
- https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/USB (read the history section): established that seven companies, Compaq, DEC, IBM, Intel, Microsoft, NEC and Nortel, began developing USB in 1995, that USB 1.0 was released in January 1996 with 1.5 and 12 Mbit/s signalling, that Ajay Bhatt and his team worked on the standard at Intel, and that the stated goal was to make it fundamentally easier to connect external devices to PCs and to replace the many connectors on PCs.
- https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ajay_Bhatt (read): established that he joined Intel in 1990, that he is described as a creator of USB rather than sole inventor (headlines call him "co-creator"), and that a 2009 Intel television advert portrayed him, played by actor Sunil Narkar.
